overview: Two classic Himachal hill towns: colonial Shimla with its Mall Road and toy train, and Manali with snow at Solang and Atal Tunnel, apple orchards and river rafting.
fit: Very kid-friendly: snow play, cable cars and gentle walks. Long road drive between the two.
season: April–June is pleasant (10–25°C), with snow still at Solang/Rohtang early on. October is clear. December–February has snow in towns. Monsoon July–August brings landslides.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Chandigarh, then 3.5 hr to Shimla; Manali back to Chandigarh 8 hr (or fly from Kullu-Bhuntar)

gettingAround: Cab with driver; Manali local taxis for Solang and Rohtang.

Atal Tunnel to Sissu
todo.why: Drive through the 9 km tunnel to snowy Lahaul

foodTips: Plenty of North and South Indian vegetarian options.
save: Fly into Chandigarh and out of Kullu to avoid the return drive
Rent snow suits at Solang, don't buy
safety: Landslides in monsoon; check the forecast
Snow sports: helmets and licensed operators
Traffic jams to Solang/Atal Tunnel; start early
kids: Snow day is the highlight for both
Keep drives under 4 hours where you can

days.plan: Fly to Chandigarh; drive to Shimla
Atal Tunnel to Sissu; fly home from Kullu or drive back
